mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roomboards ( members_username, title, detail, address, postcode, price, house_size, price_per, rent_start, rent_until, hashtags, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{dto.membersUsername}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.detail}, #{dto.address}, #{dto.postcode}, #{dto.price}, #{dto.houseSize}, #{dto.pricePer}, #{dto.rentStart}, #{dto.rentUntil}, #{dto.hashtags, typeHandler=com.aladin.common.JsonTypeHandler}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, members_username, title, detail, address, postcode, price, house_size, price_per, rent_start, rent_until, hashtags, views, created_at, updated_at FROM roomboards ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, members_username, title, detail, address, postcode, price, house_size, price_per, rent_start, rent_until, hashtags, views, created_at, updated_at FROM roomboards WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT url FROM roomboards_images WHERE roomboards_id = #{boardId} AND image_order = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roomboards_images (roomboards_id, url, image_order) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOrder});
